notes: Splits IP blocking into its own 'Security' section in the sidebar, independent of Free Service Gateway: Blocked IPs and the auto-block/cPanel IP Blocker settings moved there, with their own independently-grantable permission (previously bundled into Free Service Gateway access). The super admin account is unaffected; any additional admin users you've created will need Security access granted explicitly on the Users page if they should keep using this. No database update needed for this update.
